title: Chapter 1321
text:
Just as Han Xiao and Oulou were 'looking at each other affectionately', the galactic residents watching the live broadcast all heard the short conversation between the two parties in the public channel.

"I heard it. As long as we can defeat Black Star with our high-level combatants, he'll consider compromising."

"This is a turning point! If Black Star keeps his promise, defeating him will put an end to the flames of war and prevent an all-out war. "

"Work hard, three Universal Civilizations. The peace of the universe depends on you. If you win, it'll be a great achievement!"

"I don't think so. Black Star is the leader of the Beyond Grade As after all. Can the three Universal Civilizations defeat him? Plus, his value in the Wayne Cards is too high. I don't think Oulou can do it."

"Is this the time to talk about cards? We'll only know if they can win after they fight! "

"Speaking of which, if we can use card skills to decide the winner, it'll be much easier to have a game of diplomacy …"

The countless galactic residents were filled with hope again.

Regardless of whether Black Star was telling the truth or not, they could only place their hopes on this. No one wanted to be affected by the outbreak of war. As long as there was a turning point, it was a good thing.

At this moment, in the eyes of the galactic residents, Black Star seemed to have become a great villain. As long as they defeated him, they would be able to maintain world peace. One after another, countless people cheered for the three Universal Civilizations in their hearts, wishing that they could see Black Star lying on the ground the next second.

On the other side, in the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations' joint fleet, the other direct Beyond Grade As were watching the two of them from the command room, preparing to watch the battle.

"Do you think Oulou can defeat Black Star?" someone asked.

"Less than fifty percent. If Black Star was so easy to deal with, the higher-ups wouldn't have recruited all of us." Verena shook her head.

"Then why did they let him fight alone? Although it's not good to gang up on him, it'll be embarrassing if he loses, right? "Guzar wondered.

"We didn't expect Oulou to win in the first place." Francisco interrupted, "With Oulou's strength and Verena's enhancement, he should be able to fight Black Star on equal footing. He's just testing him."

Nodding her head, Verena explained, "That's right. Black Star hasn't fought in public for decades. With his growth rate, the information we have on him is probably outdated. No one knows what level he's at now. With Oulou's strength, he can force Black Star to show his true ability and collect information for us so that we can formulate targeted countermeasures. Anyway, we have ten days, so there's no need to rush. Only by knowing yourself and the enemy can we increase our chances of winning. "

Hearing this, everyone immediately agreed.

Black Star had dominated the universe for decades and was already recognized as a ferocious person in the Beyond Grade A circle. No one present dared to underestimate him.

Oulou was a pinnacle Beyond Grade A in the universe, one of the best among them. Letting him test Black Star right from the start was already a sign of respect in everyone's eyes.

While all the direct Beyond Grade As were having their own thoughts, Han Xiao and Oulou, who were facing each other in the middle of the battlefield, started fighting without saying a word. It was like lightning striking the earth!

Oulou's eyes lit up with a strong light as he activated the Golden Treasure Ship Dimension. The next moment, streams of resplendent golden light beams shot out from the densely packed rings behind him like a fountain. The scene was like a barrage of cannon shots.

Han Xiao was unmoved. His body shook, and Mechanical Force spread out. The mechanical army hidden in his body through (Compressed Orb Innovation-Martial Body) immediately shot out along with the Mechanical Force and expanded instantly, turning into a black mass of Mech Legion. They set up thick psionic shields and blocked in front of Han Xiao, forming a barrier.

Golden light beams bombarded the psionic shield like a storm. Golden light particles splattered everywhere, and purplish-blue electric arcs danced crazily.

Seeing this, Oulou immediately increased his strength and summoned more golden rings, shooting out scorching golden light beams endlessly toward Han Xiao's mechanical army as if energy was free.

His Esper Ability is to communicate with the Golden Treasure Ship Dimension and borrow its energy. He's also someone with an unlimited amount of energy and is best at covering fire. He often uses unlimited energy to grind his opponent to death … The Golden Treasure Ship itself is a special secondary dimension. Its energy nature is very destructive, and it also has a compound function.

Oulou's information flashed through Han Xiao's mind, but his hands were not slow. He opened the secondary dimensional army box, and more mechanical troops rushed out.

The psionic shield instantly became many times thicker. No matter how much firepower Oulou unleashed, the guards in front of Han Xiao still did not move. There was no need for Han Xiao to dodge at all. He summoned his Divine Mechanical Throne, sat on it, and commanded his troops.

At the same time, the long-range troops in the Mech Legion also began to fight back. Under the lead of the Apostle Weapons, the melee troops charged toward Oulou from all directions.

The next moment, the two sides engaged in a fierce battle. The scene was intense, and all kinds of beams of light filled the battlefield.

The three Universal Civilizations' joint fleet had no choice but to retreat a certain distance and set up shields to avoid being affected.

Sitting on the Mechanical Throne, Han Xiao's eyes followed Oulou, and his eyes flickered.

Although infinite mana was one of the characteristics of a Beyond Grade A, in his opinion, this ability had a weakness that was not a weakness. No matter how much energy one had, there was a limit to one's output. Oulou's Energy Rank was the upper limit of his output.

Oulou's Energy Rank was firmly in the top echelon, not any weaker than Kasuyi. After receiving Verena's bonuses, his Energy Rank increased even more. However, compared to Han Xiao's current Energy Rank, it was still quite far away.

After developing in a low-profile manner for decades, the bonuses from his talents were not for nothing. His combat strength was already extremely shocking. He did not even need to activate a Character Summon Card to gain the upper hand. This was the advantage of pure strength.

Han Xiao only took out ten Apostle Weapons to catch Oulou and beat him up. With his exquisite coordination, Oulou was in a rather sorry state. With the bonuses from his Mechanical Force, the combat strength of the Apostle Weapons was already firmly at the Beyond Grade A level. They could even exchange blows with high-level Beyond Grade As.

With such a huge advantage, there was no need for any fancy moves. He could just use F2A and be done with it!

One word could describe the current situation — one-sided!

"This person's threat to me is limited. He's no match for me. Losing to me is only a matter of time … Heh, if I can't even beat you, why would I have so many talents?"

After looking at it for a while, Han Xiao smirked, shook his head, and opened the interface.

Not long after Oulou issued the challenge, the long-awaited Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission finally appeared again. Fighting one on one in front of so many people clearly had enough influence to trigger a mission.

The mission type was still the same as before. The best reward was still drawing a Character Summon Card and one of the opponent's abilities.

"A fat sheep sent to my door. I love one-on-one battles the most. Isn't this forcing me to use battle to nurture battle?"

Han Xiao chuckled.

He remained calm and patiently commanded the army to fight. His various talents were still in effect, and his condition was constantly improving. The battle was getting easier and easier.

On the other hand, Oulou was having a hard time.

In the eyes of outsiders, the Mech Legion was like a black swarm of bees, constantly attacking Oulou back and forth. Although the golden beams that Oulou wantonly scattered could destroy pieces of the mechanical army from time to time, the empty positions would be quickly filled by other mechanical soldiers. Furthermore, the damaged machines would quickly reassemble and enter the battlefield again.

It looked like Oulou was an insect that had landed on a spider's web. He could only struggle in vain, breaking out of the encirclement time and time again, only to be surrounded again and again.

Oulou's expression had already changed. Only seriousness was left.

It was not that he had never fought against a pinnacle Beyond Grade A Mechanic before. This level of firepower was usually enough to cause flaws in the opponent's Mech Legion. However, up until now, Black Star's mechanical army was still like an impenetrable net, tightly covering him. Furthermore, it was so tough that he could not tear it apart no matter what.

In particular, these ten Apostle Weapons were ridiculously strong. Not only did they make him feel extremely tired, but he also did not dare let his guard down. If he was careless, he might be killed on the spot.

Attrition battles were his forte, but now, he was being suppressed.

Seeing that the situation was not going well, Oulou could not help but look at Black Star behind the mechanical army. He seemed to have an idea, and coincidentally met Han Xiao's eyes, which were filled with anticipation.

Just looking at each other, Oulou's heart skipped a beat, and he quickly gave up on the idea of attacking Han Xiao.

… I almost forgot. This guy is not a normal Mechanic. If I really did break through, I don't know who will be the one attacking who. I don't want to be killed by him.

Unable to find a way to break through, Oulou became more and more anxious. He could only continue to bombard the enemy, but the injuries on his body continued to increase as time passed.

The battle lasted for a long time. The scene was always this simple, violent, and not flashy.

At this time, Oulou suddenly erupted. The golden energy created a wave, pushing back the mechanical soldiers around him, allowing him to break out of the encirclement once again.

However, he did not charge toward Han Xiao but ran in the opposite direction, charging into the formation of the three Universal Civilizations' joint fleet. With the help of the battleships, he quickly left the battlefield.

Seeing this, Han Xiao raised his hand and stopped the mechanical army. He did not chase after Oulou and attack the joint fleet.

After watching Oulou escape into the main ship, Han Xiao then shouted in the public channel with a half-smile.

"That's it?"

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao waved his hand and recalled the mechanical soldiers in the field. He did not look angry at all, as though he had just done something insignificant.

After doing all this, Han Xiao continued to sit on the Divine Mechanical Throne calmly, holding his chin with one hand and looking at the three Universal Civilizations' fleet with his head tilted.

"Next one, please find someone who can warm me up."

Seeing this, the many galactic residents who had high hopes for Oulou suddenly felt like a basin of cold water had been poured over them. Their little flames of hope were extinguished instantly, leaving only dejection.

"He … he lost just like that?"

"Black Star didn't seem to have gotten up from the start to the end?"

"Was it too easy …"

Countless galactic residents felt a stifling sensation in their chests, unable to breathe. They were so stifled that they felt like vomiting blood.

They thought they could see a fierce battle, but they didn't expect Oulou to die so easily. He was really incompetent, and his enthusiasm was wasted.

Because they were not powerful Supers, most of them could not understand the details of the battle. They only knew that Black Star was just sitting there, not moving, while Oulou was forced to flee by the other party's mechanical army.

From the beginning to the end, the two of them did not collide at all. Oulou's side was embarrassing, while Black Star's side was full of health.

No one knew how strong a Beyond Grade A was, so they could only judge from the performance. Then, a question appeared in the minds of many galactic residents …

Was it because Oulou was too weak, or was Black Star too strong?

…

On the other side, in the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations …

When the direct Beyond Grade As who were watching the battle saw this result, they all fell silent. Their eyes were filled with shock and doubt.

As the saying went, the layman only watched for the show, while the expert watched for the technique. Only Beyond Grade As like them knew what information was contained in this battle that did not seem to have any suspense.

Black Star's Mechanical Force strength had already raised the performance of the Mech Legion to a higher level. It was a complete suppression of Energy Rank!

"The difference is actually this big?"

Verena's eyes widened in disbelief.

She knew that Oulou's chances of winning were not high, but she did not expect Black Star to win so easily, beating Oulou away with the traditional Army Style.

Originally, she had hoped that Oulou would force Black Star to use his strength so that they could collect intelligence. However, she did not expect Oulou to not even be able to complete the mission of probing. He was completely crushed by Black Star without being forced to use any of his trump cards.

This feeling was like using a skill to trick the opponent, but it was taken away by a series of simple attacks …

No matter what, Oulou was still a first-tier expert, not some random trash. However, he lost in such a cowardly manner, not gaining any advantage at all.

Just how strong is Black Star now?

"… He wasn't this strong before." Clottey said solemnly. "The only explanation is that his strength has improved again in the past few decades, and he hid it deeply."

"This is not good." Guzar's expression was serious. "You probably won't be Black Star's match even if you go up."

Clottey remained silent and did not refute. He had also lost confidence.

If he did not know Oulou's character well, he would have suspected that Oulou had gone easy on him.

I underestimated this guy. His wings are already full …

Clotti slowly exhaled a mouthful of foul air, his heart heavy.

At this time, the cabin door opened, and Oulou walked in.

Because he was really afraid that Black Star would scatter his ashes, he had run away as soon as he saw that the situation was not good. His injuries were very light, but he looked like he was in a trance, unable to accept that he had lost so easily.

Who am I? Where am I? What am I doing?

Everyone turned to look at him with mixed feelings. They didn't know what to say.

Brother, you asked for this first battle yourself. Thank you for helping us …
